title: Delhi BJP Mahila Morcha Protests Outside Congress HQ
seoTitle: Delhi BJP Mahila Morcha Protests Congress HQ

tea.why: Protesters alleged that Congress leaders misbehaved with women police personnel during previous demonstrations.
tea.want: They demanded an immediate public apology from Congress leader Rahul Gandhi.
tea.changed: Oct 8, 2026: Police stopped the march near Hindi Bhawan with a heavy barricade, after which protesters staged a sit-in before leaving.

summary: On October 8, 2026, the Delhi unit of the Bharatiya Janata Party's Mahila Morcha organised a protest march near the Congress headquarters at Indira Bhawan in Delhi. Led by figures including Delhi BJP general secretary Yogita Singh, Aarti Mehra, and Archana Gupta, the participants raised slogans and demanded an immediate public apology from Congress MP Rahul Gandhi. The demonstration was held in response to allegations that Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra had misbehaved with and struck women police personnel during earlier protests on Tuesday and Wednesday. Police deployed a heavy human barricade near Hindi Bhawan to halt the march, leading to a sit-in by the demonstrators before they were eventually warned and allowed to leave.
demands: Apology from the Congress party for disrespecting women in uniform
response: Police formed a heavy human barricade near Hindi Bhawan to forcibly stop the protest march, warned the participants after a sit-in, and allowed them to leave.

updates.text: The Delhi BJP Mahila Morcha staged a protest march near the Congress headquarters, demanding an apology from Rahul Gandhi over alleged misconduct with women police officers.
Police formed a heavy human barricade near Hindi Bhawan to halt the march, leading to a brief sit-in before protesters were permitted to disperse.
